classes.definition: claim supported to the threshold required for its claim category
account created during or near the period; perspective is preserved and not automatically universalized
later recollection by a participant or community member
recorded remembered testimony with narrator and collection provenance
circulating cultural story or belief whose factual basis is incomplete, variable, or secondary
story attached to a person, group, artifact, or event with uncertain or embellished historical status
humorous cultural artifact not asserted as literal historical fact
deliberately non-literal or exaggerated cultural artifact
subsequent narrative that may compress, simplify, merge, or embellish earlier events
